title: These are the gifts developers will actually want
author: Lavinia Sfetcu
description: The developer you're shopping for hasn’t shared their holiday wish list with you yet? Check out these gifts, plus our Black Friday discount all week long. The post These are the gifts developers will actually want appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Some people tell you exactly what they want for the holidays, but some people just don’t. The gifts, the decor, the food, for all of it, you have to guess at what they might like.
takeaways: Each GitHub-exclusive Bauer Lite kit arrives in a randomly selected color combination and includes a hot-swap PCB with RGB underglow, Omnitype Hawk linear switches, dye-sublimated PBT keycaps, and the essential hardware and tools for a hands-on custom build.
Drape a cozy blanket over you, put on some warm socks , and while your agent is busy at work you can slip on the sleep mask and have a little mid-afternoon nap.

We won’t say it’s the definitive guide for the developer in your life (or for yourself, we won’t judge), but we have brought together a few of our favorite pieces from the GitHub Shop for you to pick from.
